'''Rossin''' was a member of the [[Arad Doman]] army under [[Rodel Ituralde]].

== Activities ==
He was looking into why the trumpets sounded the retreat to early when Ituralde's force was stationed outside [[Maradon]]. He dies once the [[Trolloc]]s invade the city.
